digest.component_or_area: development process audit evaluation and decision reconciliation
propositions: Six process improvement recommendations from the frozen audit (bleakish-stational-cob) require evaluation against prior audits, decisions, and implementation outcomes before conversion to work tickets.

Prior decisions and their outcomes show that escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was partially implemented with 1.1% coverage; deterministic plan preflight already exists at P1-P11 with demonstrated low false-positive rates; and completion-failure classification requires offline validation before schema changes.
Risk-tiered review must be pilot-tested without hard merge enforcement because caused_by attribution is noisy and the project operates autonomous Gerrit voting without mandatory human review.

Debt warnings at 720 LOC already shipped; the proposed arbitrary quota thresholds should not become standalone objectives, and debt prioritization should remain tied to size/complexity/churn/defect intersection.

Maintainership/reviewer-breadth proposals misframe the problem; the actual governance gaps are autonomous-assurance independence, provider diversity monitoring, and operational continuity, not mandatory human approval.

Material limits prevent full risk-tier and escape-rate validation; force/override frequency, author-model independence auditability, and incident/SLO evidence for delivery cadence were not quantified in this evaluation.
